target: dynasty:wooden_magpie wing-root/wingtip hierarchical motion; NOT landing recovery

Seagull full study compared: two-stage wing with fly/sit/flap amount controlling transition. Sunbird has no flyProgress/landing gate and therefore cannot validate recovery, unlike that method.
No exact Sunbird whole packet found by bounded v43 filename search; global semantic novelty not proven.

Body→two wings[±8,-3,-8]15x5x6→wing1[0,-1,0]33x0x37→wing2[±32,0,0]50x0x37. Large silhouette comes from alpha-cut planes, not dozens of small featherboxes.

resetDefaultPose each draw. Wingroot flapZ at age*.2 amplitude.6; wing2 same with phase−1.2, opposite inversion per side. Wing1 no own per-frame angle. Tail1 swing age*.2 amplitude.06; tail1walk and legwalk use limbSwing/amount, bodybob amplitude3.6 from locomotion. tail2 inherits tail1; no explicit distal counter-motion.

faceTarget distributes input to neck/head then bodyX assigned interpolated birdPitch*DEG_TO_RAD. prev/currentpitch derived everytick as −verticalVelocity*RAD_TO_DEG (not clamped or smoothed beyond partial interpolation). Actual world-frame head/feet positions require hierarchical renderer; no IK or ground contact.

lifecycle_and_exit: isFlying() and isNoGravity() always true. No sitting, landing, fold, ground-state progress or authored attack/death clip. Hence cannot be credited as an implementation of wooden-magpie wing recovery.

RandomFlyGoal MOVE canUse when controller lacks wanted or targetnull; selects beaconorbit radius5 (nextInt1 always0) or altitude roaming. It can returntrue even targetnull. Continue requires targetnonnull,distanceSquared>2.4,wanted,nohorizontalcollision. stop only clears target; does not stop nav/controller or zero delta. tick can replace target and updateswanted; distance<2.5 clears target.

MoveHelper near bbox size switchesWAIT and halvesdelta; otherwise adds normalizedspeed*.05 and yaw followsvelocity or target. canReach exists but is never called in this class. Point empty/eye ray tests do not prove full giant wing sweep clearance.

Travel water*.8/lava*.5; airfriction.91 or groundfriction*.91, moveRelative.2,calculateEntityAnimation true in airbranch then false afterall. Alwaysfly still can touchground; no authored grounded pose follows.

Atfull server fullScorchTime0..30 appliesfire every5tick; >30 clearsflag and increments, nexttick resets fulltime. Pose model never consumes scorchprogress; only glow/shine consumers. Damagearea bboxinflate(15,32,15) not wingtipcontact. No scorch gameplay imported.
